datasets.name: ODSAgent
datasets.sql:
select a.rowid, a.id, a.name, a.Surname, a.fathername from ins_Agents a
order by a.surname

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
select ic.rowid,ic.* from ins_contracts ic
where ic.id = :cid
and type_id = 5

datasets.name: ODSCProperty
datasets.sql: select icp.rowid,icp.* from ins_commercialproperty icp where icp.cid=:cid

datasets.name: ODSCustomers
datasets.sql:
select * from (
SELECT a.id,a.insured_typeid, a.surname || '  ' ||a.name name, a.ADDRESS,a.mobilephone,
a.fax,a.contactperson,a.contactpersonphone
  FROM ins_customers a where a.close_prefix=0
  order by a.surname

)

datasets.name: ODSRisks
datasets.sql: select idr.rowid, idr.* from ins_dict_risks idr

datasets.name: ODSSex
datasets.sql:
select 1 as id , 'Kişi' as name from dual
union all
select 0 as id , 'Qadın' as name from dual

datasets.name: ODSAvalute
datasets.sql:
select valute, val_name, valu_name, valu_short from avalute
order by valute

datasets.name: ODSBanks
datasets.sql:
select * from bankm
order by name

datasets.name: ODSReliaseDates
datasets.sql:
select * from ins_release_date
where to_number(to_char(begindate, 'YYYY')) <= :releaseyear
and to_number(to_char(enddate, 'YYYY')) >= :releaseyear
and state_id in (select its.id from ins_tarif_states its
                  where its.state_id = :state )
